/********************************************************************/
/*  Turn on the Large File Support when *IFS64IO is specified   @B1A*/
/*  as C compiler option.                                       @B1A*/
/********************************************************************/

      #define _LARGE_FILES                                   /* @B1A*/
   #endif                                                    /* @B1A*/
   #ifndef _LARGE_FILE_API                                   /* @B1A*/
      #define _LARGE_FILE_API                                /* @B1A*/
   #endif                                                    /* @B1A*/
#endif                                                       /* @B1A*/


/*********************************************************************/
/* Values for the f_flag field of the statvfs structure              */
/*********************************************************************/
#define ST_RDONLY           00000000001 /* Read-only file system     */
#define ST_NOSUID           00000000002 /* File system does not support
                                           setuid/setgid semantics   */
#define ST_CASE_SENSITIVE   00000000004 /* File system is
                                           case sensitive            */
#define ST_CHOWN_RESTRICTED 00000000010 /* Changing the owner or
                                           primary group is
                                           restricted to a process
                                           having appropriate
                                           privileges                */
#define ST_THREAD_SAFE      00000000020 /* File system is thread-safe
                                           when accessed with a
                                           thread-safe API           */
#define ST_DYNAMIC_MOUNT    00000000040 /* Allows itself to be
                                           dynamically mounted and
                                           unmounted                 */

#define ST_NO_MOUNT_OVER    00000000100 /* File system does not
                                           support having any part of
                                           it become mounted over    */
#define ST_NO_EXPORTS       00000000200 /* File system does not
                                           allow any of its objects
                                           to be exported to the
                                           Network File System (NFS)
                                           Server                    */
#define ST_SYNCHRONOUS      00000000400 /* File system supports the
                                           "synchronous write"
                                           semantic of NFS version 2 */
#define ST_TEMPORARY        00000001000 /* File system contains only
                                           Temporary objects     @B5A*/
#define ST_PREFER_SSD       00000002000 /* File system's preferred
                                           storage media is solid state
                                           drive storage         @B6A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

struct statvfs {
  unsigned long f_bsize;        /* File system block size            */
  unsigned long f_frsize;       /* Fundamental file system block size*/
#ifdef _LARGE_FILES             /* If _LARGE_FILES is specified,
                                   redefine the following fields @A1A*/
  unsigned long long f_blocks;  /* Total number of blocks on file
                                   system in units of f_frsize       */
  unsigned long long f_bfree;   /* Total number of free blocks       */
  unsigned long long f_bavail;  /* Number of free blocks available to
                                   a non-privileged process          */
#else                           /* No Large File Support         @A1A*/
  _Bin8         f_blocks;       /* Total number of blocks on file
                                   system in units of f_frsize       */
  _Bin8         f_bfree;        /* Total number of free blocks       */
  _Bin8         f_bavail;       /* Number of free blocks available to
                                   a non-privileged process          */
#endif                                                        /* @A1A*/
  unsigned long f_files;        /* Total number of file serial
                                   numbers                           */
  unsigned long f_ffree;        /* Total number of free file serial
                                   numbers                           */
  unsigned long f_favail;       /* Number of file serial numbers
                                   available to a non-privileged
                                   process                           */
  unsigned long f_fsid;         /* File system id                    */
  unsigned long f_flag;         /* Bit mask of f_flag values         */
  unsigned long f_namemax;      /* Maximum file name length          */
  unsigned long f_pathmax;      /* Maximum path length               */
  long          f_objlinkmax;   /* Maximum number of hard links for
                                   objects other than directories    */
  long          f_dirlinkmax;   /* Maximum number of hard links for
                                   a directory                       */
  char          f_reserved1[4]; /* Reserved                      @B4C*/
  unsigned long long f_fsid64;  /* File system ID - 64 bit form  @B4A*/
  char          f_basetype[80]; /* File system type name             */
};

/*********************************************************************/
/* Define statvfs64 structure for applications that are compiled @A1A*/
/* with _LARGE_FILE_API flag.                                    @A2A*/
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef _LARGE_FILE_API                                        /* @A1A*/
struct statvfs64 {
  unsigned long f_bsize;        /* File system block size            */
  unsigned long f_frsize;       /* Fundamental file system block size*/
  unsigned long long f_blocks;  /* Total number of blocks on file
                                   system in units of f_frsize       */
  unsigned long long f_bfree;   /* Total number of free blocks       */
  unsigned long long f_bavail;  /* Number of free blocks available to
                                   a non-privileged process          */
  unsigned long f_files;        /* Total number of file serial
                                   numbers                           */
  unsigned long f_ffree;        /* Total number of free file serial
                                   numbers                           */
  unsigned long f_favail;       /* Number of file serial numbers
                                   available to a non-privileged
                                   process                           */
  unsigned long f_fsid;         /* File system id                    */
  unsigned long f_flag;         /* Bit mask of f_flag values         */
  unsigned long f_namemax;      /* Maximum file name length          */
  unsigned long f_pathmax;      /* Maximum path length               */
  long          f_objlinkmax;   /* Maximum number of hard links for
                                   objects other than directories    */
  long          f_dirlinkmax;   /* Maximum number of hard links for
                                   a directory                       */
  char          f_reserved1[4]; /* Reserved                      @B4C*/
  unsigned long long f_fsid64;  /* File system ID - 64 bit form  @B4A*/
  char          f_basetype[80]; /* File system type name             */
};
#endif                                                        /* @A1A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Function Prototypes                                               */
/*********************************************************************/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Map existing APIs to 64 bit version for _LARGE_FILES flag.    @A1A*/
/*********************************************************************/
#ifdef _LARGE_FILES             /* Map for Large File support    @A1A*/
  #pragma map (statvfs, "statvfs64")                     /* @A1A @A2C*/
  #pragma map (fstatvfs, "fstatvfs64")                   /* @A1A @A2C*/
#endif

QBFC_EXTERN int statvfs(const char *, struct statvfs *);
QBFC_EXTERN int fstatvfs(int, struct statvfs *);

/*********************************************************************/
/* Define new APIs _LARGE_FILE_API flag.                         @A1A*/
/*********************************************************************/
#ifdef _LARGE_FILE_API        /* New APIs for Large File Support @A1A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int statvfs64(const char *, struct statvfs64 *);/* @A1A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int fstatvfs64(int, struct statvfs64 *);        /* @A1A*/
#endif                                                        /* @A1A*/

#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))    /*@B2A*/

  #ifdef _LARGE_FILES              /* Map for Large File support @B2A*/
     #pragma map (QlgStatvfs, "QlgStatvfs64")                 /* @B2A*/
  #endif
                                                               /*@B2A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int QlgStatvfs(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,                /*@B2A*/
                             struct statvfs *);                /*@B2A*/
   #ifdef _LARGE_FILE_API                                      /*@B2A*/
     QBFC_EXTERN int QlgStatvfs64(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,           /*@B2A*/
                             struct statvfs64 *);              /*@B2A*/
   #endif                                                      /*@B2A*/
                                                               /*@B2A*/
#endif                                                         /*@B2A*/

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=510)                                   /* @B3A*/
#pragma datamodel(pop)                                        /* @B3A*/
#endif                                                        /* @B3A*/

#endif /* __statvfs_h */
